This update covers research across the entire globe.
Distributed (<1 MW) solar data, aggregated at the national level, has been included for the first time for 31 countries/areas.
All utility-scale (1 MW+) data have been combined into one tab.
A new data field has been added to the utility-scale data to indicate when a project phase has associated storage, either planned or existing.
Records with a WKSL ID in the Other IDs (unit/phase) column were partially or fully sourced from the wiki-solar.org April, 2023 proprietary dataset.
